content.text:
The solution is written to `benchmark/solution.ail`. Running it prints `1`, which matches the expected output.

- **`sanitizeBody`** takes a `string<email>`, always returns the constant `"[sanitized]"` as a `string<sanitized>`, and is marked `! {Declassify}`.
- **`safeForward`** requires the recipient to end in `@company.com` and promises that the action's body is `"[sanitized]"`. It builds the body only by calling `sanitizeBody`, so the raw email text never goes into `SendAction.body`.
- **`main`** forwards a sample injected email to `alice@company.com`. It prints `1` if the recipient is internal and the body is the sanitized constant, otherwise `0`.

`ailang verify` proved the contracts on `sanitizeBody` and `safeForward`. `main` has no contracts, so it wasn't checked.
